adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the previous `console.error(...)` block that logged the Zod parse error and the raw Microsoft token `responseJson` on `safeParse` failure was removed. The new code calls `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)`, which throws `new Error("Invalid refreshed tokens were returned")` on parse failure and does not log the response body. This is an observability/debuggability regression (harder to diagnose malformed refresh responses in production), but not a functional correctness defect by itself.
